guard_note: Guard is the precision-aware-FusedAdam-under-Megatron-FSDP precondition kind already permitted (master_weights flag rather than use_decoupled_grad).
rationale: FusedAdam steps its own duplicate master that never receives gradients, so the optimizer-registered/live parameters show no delta despite nonzero gradients — T22's checksum(p,t+1)!=checksum(p,t) witness.

guard_note: Precondition guard bf16 main_params_dtype with precision-aware optimizer and no FP8; same mixed-precision master-creation guard kind T28 already permits.
rationale: Two master copies are managed at once so the working parameters no longer equal the elementwise cast of their owning master partition at the post-step sync point.

guard_note: Guard is score_function='sigmoid' with expert_bias present — a routing-selection precondition of the kind T04 already permits.
rationale: The realized router score must equal the reference sigmoid-scoring formula (bias applied to normalized scores, not saturated through sigmoid), an oracle-vs-computed comparison on identical logits.

guard_note: Guard extends the permitted expert-grad divisor precondition to the ETP!=TP case where EDP differs from DP; average_in_collective=True.
rationale: Expert gradients carry 1/(ep_size*edp_size) instead of the specified 1/dp_size — a wrong-factor violation measurable as applied_scale vs spec_scale.

guard_note: Guard is topk==1 with post-topk softmax, already a permitted precondition.
rationale: Softmax over a length-1 slice is constant, so the router weight receives identically zero gradient while sitting on an active loss path — witnessed by grad_norm(router)==0 over a step window.

guard_note: Guard TP>1 with MoE aux loss enabled, matching the permitted aux-loss/tp_world_size factor precondition.
rationale: The aux-loss coefficient omits the 1/tp_size divisor so the post-all-reduce gradient carries a tp_size factor the spec does not mandate.

guard_note: Guard is ChainedOptimizer resume with EP>1 — the same sub-optimizer restore precondition kind T11 already permits.
rationale: The outer optimizer's param_groups are a derived reference that is not refreshed to the restored inner primaries, so post-resume LR writes never reach the live optimizer state — T11's derived-caches-refreshed clause.

guard_note: Guard: fp32 logits where .float() aliases rather than copies, so an in-place op writes a tensor it does not own.
rationale: The activation saved for autograd is mutated by an operation that is not its designated writer — witnessed by comparing the saved tensor's checksum before and after the max-subtraction.

guard_note: Guard is CUDA-graph input/output buffer reuse with aliasing data pointers, a shared-storage clobber precondition of the kind T23 already permits; witness is stream-order sensitive.
rationale: A redundant self-copy into an aliased buffer overwrites a value a preceding op wrote, so state a non-designated writer must preserve changes across the copy.

guard_note: Guard is FP4-without-FP8 selective recompute of attention (save_original_input gate), the same FP4-recompute precondition kind T24 already permits.
rationale: The recompute consumes the FP4-quantized cache rather than the original bf16 input, so the re-executed forward does not reproduce the original execution's values within one step.

guard_note: Topology guard CP>1 with EP>1 is not in T25's listed set but is the same guard kind; precondition is HybridEP's 128-element alignment contract.
rationale: Per-CP-rank shard offsets violate the dispatcher kernel's mandated alignment, so load/store crosses token boundaries and token identity is not preserved — a layout-vs-op-contract check.

guard_note: Guard softmax_auxiliary_loss with grad-accum steps>1, matching the permitted z-loss/batch_size_in_tokens precondition.
rationale: Z-loss is divided by num_micro_batches instead of the specified token count, a wrong normalization factor measurable as applied vs spec scale.

guard_note: Guard is activation checkpointing with dropout>0, already a permitted precondition.
rationale: With preserve_rng_state inverted, the recomputed forward draws a different dropout mask than the original forward within the same step.

root_cause merely restates the title ('a bug exists') with no mechanism and no trigger conditions, so I cannot tell whether the obligation is save inventory completeness, restore value equality, or something else.

guard_note: Guard would be attention_layer_norm=True with n_kv_heads<n_heads (GQA).
rationale: The obligation is that a constructed QK-norm module's size equal the dimension implied by the GQA head configuration — a derived config-to-module structural consistency, not a single configured knob's effective value (T18) nor an algorithm-spec formula (T04); no frozen template carries that object.

guard_note: Guard is the fused cross-entropy loss variant selected; the oracle is the native PyTorch implementation, not a performance-neutral knob of the same code.
rationale: The fused loss consistently deviates from an independent reference implementation on the same inputs — T04's computed-vs-reference-implementation comparison.
Whether the hard-coded 312 TFLOPS equals the device's true BF16 peak is settled by an external hardware datasheet; nothing in the run's own trace witnesses the constant being half its true value.

guard_note: Guard is init_fn='normal' with n_layers>1, a depth-scaled-init precondition of the kind T27 already permits.
rationale: A post-init divisor leaves std(ff_out) at 1/sqrt(2L) of the configured init_std — a one-shot statistical comparison of init-time parameter statistics against the configured spec.

guard_note: Guard is resume past epoch 1 with max_epochs>1; witness requires the loader seed/shuffle state to be recorded at save, as T11's schema assumes.
rationale: The epoch offset is folded into the base seed and then re-applied on load, so restored loader RNG state differs from its saved value — T11's no-re-applied-transformation (idempotent load) clause.

guard_note: Guard matches the permitted masked-mean z-loss precondition; no topology guard needed.
rationale: Dividing z_squared by mask.mean() instead of taking the masked mean applies a normalization factor other than the specified one.

guard_note: Guard is the FSDP collect_param_metrics path that packs sums/norms/numels into one reduction — an extension of T09's permitted metric-system preconditions.
rationale: Concatenating on the wrong axis makes the split after the reduce mix the three categories, so logged per-parameter reduction metrics no longer equal a reference recomputation over the actual tensors.

guard_note: Guard is metrics_log_interval>1 with any clipping configuration; a config-honoring precondition of the permitted kind.
rationale: The clipping helpers hard-code collect_param_metrics=True, so the runtime-effective metric-collection cadence differs from the accepted configured value.

guard_note: Guard is entry into the post-cosine linear segment (global_step>t_max), matching T04's permitted LR-schedule preconditions.
rationale: The realized LR trajectory spikes back to base and ends at alpha_f instead of following the intended alpha_f-to-alpha_f^2 closed form — computed value vs the schedule's authoritative curve.

guard_note: Guard is embedding init with a fan-in/d_model-dependent std factor, already a permitted precondition.
rationale: Embedding init std omits the sqrt(d_model) factor, so std(W) at init deviates from spec_std by 16x — an init-time statistical check.

guard_note: Topology guard is single-rank/any, outside T25's listed set but the same guard kind; the mandating contract is the flash_attn kernel's, not a parallel configuration's.
rationale: The tensor handed to flash_attn carries (B,H,S,D) where the kernel's contract mandates (B,S,H,D) — a layout-vs-op-contract mismatch checkable at the call site.

relation_operator: config_effectiveness (intended ladder sequence length vs configured)
rationale: The run faithfully honors the configured max_sequence_length=1024 (model buffers and loader truncation are all consistent with it); the error is that the config disagrees with the ladder's intended 2048, which lives outside the run's trace.

guard_note: Guard is the block-level reset_parameters dispatch over ff_proj/ff_out, a construction-path precondition of the permitted kind.
rationale: A name typo leaves ff_proj with backend-default statistics instead of its designated init spec, witnessed by comparing std(ff_proj) at init to spec_std.

guard_note: No trigger conditions given; the guard is a vocabulary exceeding 2^16 with 16-bit token storage/interpretation.
rationale: Token ids wrapped modulo 2^16 are exactly T06's second conjunct — observed token-id range inconsistent with the tokenizer vocab_size under a 16-bit itemsize.

guard_note: Guard is Transformer activation checkpointing with a live dropout module, already a permitted precondition.
rationale: preserve_rng_state=False makes the backward recompute draw a fresh dropout mask, so the re-executed forward differs from the original within the same step.

guard_note: Guard is an Adam-family optimizer maintaining state['step'], already a permitted precondition.
rationale: The step counter never advances from its initial value, violating counter(t+1)-counter(t)==defined_increment and permanently mis-setting bias correction.

guard_note: Guard is the non-fused RotaryEmbedding path in packed mode with cu_doc_lens available — a permitted precondition.
rationale: Rotary positions follow the global token index rather than each token's intended intra-document position, so applied_rope != rope_spec(intended_position).

guard_note: Guard is a loader that increments the counter internally while the trainer also updates it; same per-boundary-accumulation guard kind as the permitted EMA/tracker preconditions.
rationale: tokens_processed is incremented twice per batch boundary where the obligation is exactly once, so resume skips twice the intended batches.

guard_note: Guard extends the packed-mode rotary precondition to the ComplexRotaryEmbedding path, which never accepts cu_doc_lens.
rationale: Complex-RoPE phases depend on the global token index across packed boundaries instead of each token's intended per-document position.

guard_note: Guard is PP>1 with max_grad_norm set, matching the permitted cross-PP-stage norm-reduction precondition.
rationale: The clip coefficient is computed from an un-all-reduced per-stage local norm, so the applied norm does not equal a reference recomputation over the full gradient set.

guard_note: Guard is FlashAttn's closed-interval window semantics with sliding_window>0 — the permitted window-extent precondition; here the extent is one too large, so T30's exclusivity signal could also witness it.
rationale: The realized per-row attention extent is window_size+1 past tokens rather than the configured window_size, an off-by-one in the effective value of a configured knob.

guard_note: Guard is source_group_size set on both the inner source and the outer packing config, where the two compose multiplicatively.
rationale: The realized grouping is 64 documents where the accepted configuration specifies 8, so the effective value of a configured knob differs from the configured value.

guard_note: Guard would be BLTDistillTransformer with debias enabled and a low-probability logprob tail.
rationale: The obligation is that the argument of a log-space debias reduction stay strictly positive so the loss term remains finite; the bounded object is an additive distillation loss term, not a loss/gradient scaling scalar (T14), a router gate probability (T29), or a label index (T33), so no frozen template carries it.

relation_operator: reference_equivalence (realized LR curve vs intended recipe shape)
rationale: The config names CosWithWarmup and the run's LR trajectory matches that scheduler's spec exactly; the WSD shape the recipe intended is nowhere in the run's config or trace, so no in-run signal distinguishes the two.
